comment: Communities and districts along the Airport→Kingston→Bog Walk→Fern Gully→Ocho Rios route. Each entry shows a community sign in-game (Recognition layer 2). needs_owner_review: true entries are uncertain — owner's lived knowledge is authoritative over map data.

communities.name: Port Royal
communities.note: Historic pirate port, now a quiet fishing village at the tip of the Palisadoes

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Gateway from the Palisadoes strip into Kingston — Harbour View roundabout

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial community just past Harbour View, home to the Rockfort Mineral Bath

communities.name: Bournemouth
communities.note: Seaside community along Windward Road

communities.name: Rollington Town
communities.note: Inner-city community in East Kingston

communities.name: Arnett Gardens
communities.note: Trenchtown adjacent — the heart of Kingston's music and sporting culture

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major Kingston junction — the old crossroads of the city

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern business district — hotels, banks, Emancipation Park

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The commercial heart of St. Andrew — clock tower, market, madness

communities.name: Liguanea
communities.note: Uptown residential and commercial district east of Half Way Tree

communities.name: Constant Spring
communities.note: North Kingston suburb — Usain Bolt's Tracks & Records is on Constant Spring Road

communities.name: Whitehall
communities.note: Community west of Half Way Tree along Hagley Park Road

communities.name: Waterhouse
communities.note: Inner-city community, sports and music heritage

communities.name: March Pen
communities.note: Community along the Spanish Town Road western corridor

communities.name: Gregory Park
communities.note: Portmore-adjacent community, gateway to the west

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: St. Catherine's capital and Jamaica's first capital city — iron bridge, history everywhere

communities.name: Central Village
communities.note: New Town northwest of Spanish Town

communities.name: Caymanas
communities.note: Estate land and housing development north of Spanish Town — Caymanas racecourse nearby

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: The famous low stone bridge over the Rio Cobre at the mouth of Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Scenic gorge community — the Rio Cobre runs beside the road through sheer cliff walls

communities.name: Riversdale
communities.note: Small community at the top end of Bog Walk gorge

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Where the gorge opens up — alumina plant country, St. Catherine/St. Ann border area

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Famous for Linstead Market — 'Carry mi ackee go a Linstead market…'

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Mountain community on the ascent from Linstead — notorious for fog and sharp bends

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Crossroads town in the St. Ann hills — the natural watershed between Kingston and the north coast

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop stop — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival. The only correct answer is to stop.

communities.name: Clarksonville
communities.note: Community descending into Fern Gully from the north-St. Ann side

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: A 3km canopy road through a ravine — once a riverbed, now a cathedral of ferns and trees

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Jamaica's north coast resort town — Dunn's River Falls is your finish line
